passages.section: What this guide records
passages.quote: The classical cell theorem takes a complete cell-system condition as an input and concludes the two breakdown statements. The numerical certificate that would supply a particular instance is absent from the supplied repository.

anchor.heading: What this guide records

passages.section: 1. A profile gives a space obstruction
passages.quote: If a smooth recurrent similarity profile satisfying the formal derivative and pressure bounds exists, then for every positive viscosity there is a smooth compactly supported divergence-free datum with no global smooth solution of uniformly bounded energy.

anchor.heading: 1. A profile gives a space obstruction

passages.section: 1. A profile gives a space obstruction
passages.quote: The formal profile premise includes spatial derivative bounds through order two and a bound on the pressure gradient. The public space predicate quantifies over a global competitor and one energy bound for all nonnegative times. It does not retain the constructed trajectory, its blow-up rate or its convergence to a chosen profile.

anchor.heading: 1. A profile gives a space obstruction

passages.section: 1. A profile gives a space obstruction
passages.quote: The quantitative construction is visible earlier: the transfer interface builds a mild trajectory from a dense data subspace and records convergence in similarity variables. Its listed proof still takes the dichotomy result as an input; the concrete assembly supplies that result.

anchor.heading: 1. A profile gives a space obstruction

passages.section: 1. A profile gives a space obstruction
passages.quote: The Fourier realization supplies the abstract evolution with a concrete interpretation as physical velocity fields. Its energy, reconstruction and regularity statements are the joins needed to interpret the abstract trajectory as a PDE solution.

anchor.heading: 1. A profile gives a space obstruction

passages.section: 2. A profile gives a periodic obstruction
passages.quote: If a smooth recurrent similarity profile satisfying the formal bounds exists, then for every positive viscosity there is a smooth divergence-free periodic datum with no global smooth solution whose velocity remains periodic.

anchor.heading: 2. A profile gives a periodic obstruction

passages.section: 2. A profile gives a periodic obstruction
passages.quote: The exported periodic obstruction allows arbitrary smooth pressure in the excluded competitor. The moving-frame reduction preserves its original datum and makes the pressure periodic as well; it does not assert that the velocity has zero mean.

anchor.heading: 2. A profile gives a periodic obstruction

passages.section: 2. A profile gives a periodic obstruction
passages.quote: The torus construction combines localization, a right-inverse comparison, perturbation and gluing. The abstract torus assembly still names the analytic inputs it needs; the final provider supplies those inputs for the concrete realization.

anchor.heading: 2. A profile gives a periodic obstruction

passages.section: 3. A weak profile has two onward routes
passages.quote: If a weak recurrent similarity profile satisfying the formal integrability, nonzero and recurrence conditions exists, then the formal whole-space breakdown statement follows.

anchor.heading: 3. A weak profile has two onward routes

passages.section: 3. A weak profile has two onward routes
passages.quote: The direct whole-space proof turns the weak field into a mild recurrent orbit. The separate torus route first constructs a smooth decaying profile and then uses the smooth-profile periodic theorem.

anchor.heading: 3. A weak profile has two onward routes

passages.section: 3. A weak profile has two onward routes
passages.quote: The internal smoothing interface preserves the input period and isometry and represents the supplied orbit almost everywhere in space at each time. The later existential profile export hides that relationship, so a reader seeking estimates for the same selected profile should open the internal interface.

anchor.heading: 3. A weak profile has two onward routes

passages.section: 4. A certificate gives a weak profile
passages.quote: If the earlier formal certificate hypothesis holds, then a weak recurrent similarity profile exists.

anchor.heading: 4. A certificate gives a weak profile

passages.section: 4. A certificate gives a weak profile
passages.quote: If the extended formal certificate hypothesis holds, then a weak recurrent similarity profile exists.

anchor.heading: 4. A certificate gives a weak profile

passages.section: 4. A certificate gives a weak profile
passages.quote: The closed extended construction supplies the named analytic nodes to the certificate assembly. For each admissible parameter it obtains a correction by contraction, proves the needed continuity, and then finds a parameter at which the total multiplier vanishes.

anchor.heading: 4. A certificate gives a weak profile

passages.section: 4. A certificate gives a weak profile
passages.quote: The weak-profile export from a held correction existentially returns a period and fields without retaining their identity with the selected parameter and correction. Its proof constructs those witnesses, but the exported proposition does not state the equalities needed by the full near-candidate conclusion of Theorem 7.1.

anchor.heading: 4. A certificate gives a weak profile

passages.section: 4. A certificate gives a weak profile
passages.quote: The conversion to the earlier certificate data type reuses an operator carrier and fills several older fields with zero. It supplies no theorem that those converted data satisfy the earlier certificate predicate.

anchor.heading: 4. A certificate gives a weak profile

passages.section: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route
passages.quote: For any seven classical cell-data arguments satisfying the fifteen-field cell-system condition, the formal whole-space breakdown statement follows.

anchor.heading: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route

passages.section: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route
passages.quote: For the same seven classical cell-data arguments, the same fifteen-field condition also implies the formal periodic breakdown statement.

anchor.heading: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route

passages.section: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route
passages.quote: The combined classical cell theorem returns both breakdown statements under the full cell-system condition.

anchor.heading: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route

passages.section: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route
passages.quote: The closed cell analysis supplies general analytic interfaces for cells, traces, rows and tree estimates. The full input condition still contains structural, functional and quantitative obligations for the particular cell system.

anchor.heading: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route

passages.section: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route
passages.quote: The composition theorem produces an extended certificate after replacing its decay constant by a suitable real bound. A wrapper that promises a conclusion for the original certificate must justify transporting that conclusion across the change.

anchor.heading: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route

passages.section: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route
passages.quote: The classical condition lives in CellLayerSystem and has fifteen fields. The fractional condition lives in CellCert.CellSystem, has twelve fields and uses exponent 501/500. The two full names identify different hypotheses.

anchor.heading: 5. The cell condition supplies the analytic route

passages.section: 6. A statement node needs its supplying proof
passages.quote: A proposition definition records a statement. It does not record a later theorem that proves it. For the transfer step, the reader needs the statement, the conditional construction and the assembly that supplies the intermediate steps as separate selectable declarations.

anchor.heading: 6. A statement node needs its supplying proof

passages.section: 6. A statement node needs its supplying proof
passages.quote: The closed-graph interface says that each element has the required half-order derivative relation. The main certificate assembly supplies it pointwise with halfSsp_of_xbar. The physical-energy provider then takes this closed-graph interface as its premise.

anchor.heading: 6. A statement node needs its supplying proof

passages.section: 6. A statement node needs its supplying proof
passages.quote: A supplying theorem can return a conjunction. The embedding-norm and embedding-linearity statements use different components of the same theorem; a navigation link to that provider should keep the chosen component visible.

anchor.heading: 6. A statement node needs its supplying proof

passages.section: 7. Fractional extensions have separate endpoints
passages.quote: The fractional profile exports concern dissipation exponents strictly between one and five quarters. Their whole-space and torus conclusions belong to a separate equation family from the classical paper route.

anchor.heading: 7. Fractional extensions have separate endpoints

passages.section: 7. Fractional extensions have separate endpoints
passages.quote: The fractional certificate and fractional cell-system exports are additional selected targets. Solution imports their providers alongside the classical providers, so its combined import closure should be distinguished from the import closure of an individual classical provider.

anchor.heading: 7. Fractional extensions have separate endpoints

Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.CellSystemCond.text: The live definition has fifteen fields and seven data arguments; each field remains a premise of the public blow-up implication.

Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.breakdownOnSpa.text: The conjunction combines the two conditional breakdown conclusions without constructing satisfying cell data.

Breakdown.BreakdownOnSpace.text: The target rules out global smooth competitors with one energy bound valid for every nonnegative time.

Breakdown.PeriodicSimilarityProfileExist.text: The formal premise includes spatial derivatives through order two and decay of the pressure gradient.

Breakdown.TransferHolds.text: The statement retains a power-law convergence rate in similarity variables for an initial datum in any dense subspace.

Breakdown.transferHolds_of_dichotomy.text: All transfer interfaces are discharged here except the explicit abstract spectral dichotomy input.

Breakdown.DichotomyHolds.text: The statement includes finite rank, forward decay, backward bounds and surjectivity on the exceptional range.

Breakdown.dichotomyHolds.text: This closed theorem supplies the abstract spectral input required by the transfer assembly.

Breakdown.exists_blowup_datum.text: The internal theorem keeps the mild flow, recurrent orbit and convergence rate that the public breakdown export forgets.

Breakdown.Freq.realization.text: This data-valued assembly supplies the concrete fields of the abstract Realization interface.

Breakdown.FieldReading.text: The bridge retains injectivity and covariance of the recovered L6 velocity.

Breakdown.fieldReading_realization.text: The proof instantiates FieldReading with the concrete Fourier realization and velocity map.

Breakdown.MildRegular.text: A physical smooth representative with energy and gradient bounds is produced on every fixed closed mild interval.

Breakdown.mildRegular_realization.text: The proof supplies concrete heat, bilinear and H1 identities to the physical regularity construction.

Breakdown.BreakdownOnTorus.text: The target encodes unit spatial periodicity on Euclidean space and keeps no convergence rate.

Breakdown.Periodic.MovingFrameReduction.text: A time-dependent frame removes the affine pressure term while preserving the initial datum.

Breakdown.Periodic.movingFrameReduction.text: The proof integrates the linear pressure drift twice to choose a frame whose initial shift and velocity vanish.

Breakdown.Periodic.TorusBlowup.text: The internal endpoint keeps a mild trajectory with no uniform Hilbert norm bound before its terminal time.

Breakdown.Periodic.torusBlowup_of_parts.text: This long assembly consumes the approximation, inverse-transfer, gluing and nonvanishing contracts.

Breakdown.Periodic.breakdownOnTorus_of_p.text: The assembly follows the smooth embedded-profile route and retains the profile premise.

Breakdown.WeakProfile.WeakOrbitOfParts.text: The output existentially packages the orbit, period and twist and hides the input-to-output field correspondence.

Breakdown.WeakProfile.weakOrbitOfParts_h.text: The proof uses the original period and twist and a continuous representative, while the Hessian clauses are unpacked but unused.

Breakdown.breakdownOnSpace_of_weak.text: This assembly discharges the weak-profile conversion before calling the common orbit-to-breakdown route.

Breakdown.FarField.periodicLerayProfileE.text: The final existential implication hides the original weak witness correspondence; internal smoothing preserves more data.

Breakdown.FarField.SmoothFieldOfOrbit.text: The interface preserves the input period and isometry and identifies the smooth field with the orbit almost everywhere in space at every time.

Breakdown.FarField.smoothFieldOfOrbit_ho.text: The interface preserves the input period and isometry and identifies the smooth field with the orbit almost everywhere in space at every time.

Breakdown.extended_certificate_orbit_pro.text: ExtendedMain supplies every analytic node in ExtendedAssembly and returns an existential weak profile.

Breakdown.Cert.extended_certificate_orbi.text: Unit-weight and at-profile transformations prepare the certificate for the normalised assembly.

Breakdown.Cert.extendedHeldExistsUniqueH.text: Uniqueness concerns corrections within the held set at each fixed parameter, not uniqueness of all Navier-Stokes solutions.

Breakdown.Cert.extendedExistsZeroHeldHol.text: The finite-dimensional zero argument selects a parameter only after the fixed-parameter nonlinear solves.

Breakdown.Held.testSetZero.text: Compactness and convexity of the encoded test set support the finite-dimensional parameter selection.

Breakdown.Cert.ExtendedSigmaProfileOfHel.text: The output existential omits its relation to the supplied parameter and correction, although the proof uses those witnesses.

Breakdown.Cert.extendedSigmaProfileOfHel.text: The output existential omits its relation to the supplied parameter and correction, although the proof uses those witnesses.

Breakdown.ExtendedCertificateData.toCert.text: Several earlier fields are set to zero so the extended proof can reuse operators; this conversion does not establish IsCertificate.

Breakdown.CertCell.cellLayerParts_closed.text: This proof bundle closes the analytic cell machinery; it supplies no concrete satisfying numerical cell data.

Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.spaceBreakdown.text: This provider supplies the analytic bridges while keeping CellSystemCondition as the full input condition.

Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.isExtendedCert.text: The conclusion permits replacement of the decay constant by an existential real bound; all other data are retained.

Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.CellSystem.text: This twelve-field condition at exponent 501/500 differs from the classical fifteen-field condition in CellLayerSystem.

Breakdown.transferHolds_of.text: The assembly uses a chosen dense-subspace datum and retains the geometric convergence estimate in its output.

Breakdown.Cert.GraphClosedHolds.text: The statement quantifies over each graph element; ExtendedMain supplies it pointwise with halfSsp_of_xbar.

Breakdown.Cert.halfSsp_of_xbar.text: Each element of the closed graph satisfies the half-order derivative relation used to identify physical energy.

Breakdown.Cert.ReadingEnergyHolds.text: The same reading identifies both weighted energy and pin pairings; the provider takes the closed-graph interface as an input.

Breakdown.Cert.readingEnergyHolds_of.text: The same reading identifies both weighted energy and pin pairings; the provider takes the closed-graph interface as an input.

Breakdown.Freq.EmbedNorm.text: The squared X norm equals the sum of the three squared component-derivative L2 norms for decay fields.

Breakdown.Freq.EmbedLinear.text: The second component of embedNormLinear_holds supplies addition, subtraction and scalar multiplication on decay fields.

Breakdown.Freq.embedNormLinear_holds.text: The theorem packages the norm identity together with linearity, so the norm edge uses its first component.

Breakdown.fractional_breakdown_on_space.text: The additional root assumes a rotating fractional profile and a dissipation exponent strictly between one and five quarters.

Breakdown.fractional_breakdown_on_torus.text: This extension has the same open exponent range as the space route and is outside the paper's stated routes.

Breakdown.SteadyCert.fracCertificate_pro.text: The fractional certificate gives a rotating fractional profile through its separate regularity and decay construction.

Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.fractional.text: This root fixes the exponent to 501/500 and uses a different CellSystemCondition from the classical cell layer.
